teacher.name: completion-safe context-gated online rank ensemble
teacher.evaluation_mode: online/prequential validation; not a static submission

transferable_strategy: Use within-user ordinal ranks rather than calibrated probabilities when blending heterogeneous rankers.
Model recent user, item, author, music, tag, type, duration, and user-context state at several time scales.
Route small residual corrections by outcome-free slate size, session count, activity, and training-history coverage.
Treat weak diverse models as possible signed residuals or anti-experts, with zero-preferring weights.
Accept a correction only when its locked direction is stable across disjoint actual-user-ID folds.
submission_safe_translation: Never expose evaluation-period long_view, play_time_ms, click, like, follow, comment, forward, or hate outcomes to the student at prediction time.

Distill the teacher's within-user ranks or residuals into a frozen student using only identity, metadata, time, exposure order, repeat, slate, session, and training-history features available before the target period.
Select the student on an earlier temporal screen, freeze it, and evaluate on a later untouched period; do not train on teacher targets from the period being scored.
For the final hidden export, refit only on information dated no later than 2022-04-28 and generate every hidden score in one pass without hidden outcomes.
priority_experiments: Ablate outcome-free exposure and session-state proxies for the teacher's unavailable feedback features.
Use a multi-task student anchored by observed training labels and regularized by teacher ordering, rather than imitating the teacher score alone.
Train separate sparse-user and dense-user students, then route with a frozen training-coverage gate.
Use the 24-hour pairwise ranker as the first simpler teacher before attempting the full gated ensemble.
